### The dynamic change of Foundation, Extension, Generalization (Replicate Table S3, S4)
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(modelsummary)
library(stargazer)
library(fixest)

# input: get_efg_s3_merge_with_concept.py output (gen_V3 columns + top_concept,
# already filtered rt>=1 / ct>=5 / pub_year<2025). Paths are relative to this
# Rmd's directory (knitr sets the working dir there). Columns are renamed to the
# names used by the models below.
df <- fread("../openalex/data/efg_computation/gen_V3_y5_with_top_concept_rt_1_ct_5_ybefore_2025.csv",
            select = c("pub_year", "citation_count_y5", "up_refer_count", "f_y5", "e_y5", "g_y5", "top_concept"))
setnames(df,
         old = c("citation_count_y5", "f_y5", "e_y5", "g_y5"),
         new = c("citation_count", "foundation", "extension", "generalization"))

df = subset(df, citation_count >= 5)
df_p1 = subset(df, pub_year < 1991 & pub_year >= 1945)
df_p2 = subset(df, pub_year >= 1991 & pub_year < 2020)

### the first period

hist(log(df_p1$citation_count+1))
hist(log(df_p1$up_refer_count+1))
hist(df_p1$foundation)
hist(df_p1$extension)
hist(df_p1$generalization)

# remove outlier
df_p1_no_outlier = subset(df_p1, citation_count < exp(5) & up_refer_count < exp(5) & foundation < 0.8)
df_p1_no_outlier$year_index = df_p1_no_outlier$pub_year - 1945



model_p1_f = feols(foundation~
                 log(up_refer_count + 1)
                + log(citation_count + 1)
                + year_index
                | top_concept
                ,data = df_p1_no_outlier)
summary(model_p1_f)




model_p1_e = feols(extension~
                 log(up_refer_count + 1)
                + log(citation_count + 1)
                + year_index
                | top_concept

                ,data = df_p1_no_outlier)
summary(model_p1_e)




model_p1_g = feols(generalization~
                 log(up_refer_count + 1)
                + log(citation_count + 1)
                + year_index
                | top_concept

                ,data = df_p1_no_outlier)
summary(model_p1_g)



### the second period

hist(log(df_p2$citation_count+1))
hist(log(df_p2$up_refer_count+1))
hist(df_p2$foundation)
hist(df_p2$extension)
hist(df_p2$generalization)


df_p2_no_outlier = subset(df_p2, citation_count < exp(6) & up_refer_count < exp(5) & foundation < 0.8)
df_p2_no_outlier$year_index = df_p2_no_outlier$pub_year - 1991




model_p2_f = feols(foundation~
                 log(up_refer_count + 1)
                + log(citation_count + 1)
                + year_index
                | top_concept

                ,data = df_p2_no_outlier)
summary(model_p2_f)




model_p2_e = feols(extension~
                 log(up_refer_count + 1)
                + log(citation_count + 1)
                + year_index
                | top_concept

                ,data = df_p2_no_outlier)
summary(model_p2_e)




model_p2_g = feols(generalization~
                 log(up_refer_count + 1)
                + log(citation_count + 1)
                + year_index
                | top_concept

                ,data = df_p2_no_outlier)
summary(model_p2_g)


```







### The relationship between F, E, G index and cross-paper distance (reference and title)  (Replicate Table S5)
```{r}

library(data.table)
library(modelsummary)
library(stargazer)
library(fixest)

# for title and reference
# input: combine_cross_dist.py full (not by-domain) output; columns already match.
df <- fread("../openalex/data/cited_reference_text_distance_citing_t/merged_dist_min_y_1951_max_y_2020_p_l_5_r_t_1_c_t_5_title.csv", select = c("pub_year", "citation_count", "up_refer_count", "pillar_ratio", "extension_ratio", "generalization_ratio", "refer_dist_mean", "title_dist_mean"))


hist(log(df$citation_count+1))
hist(log(df$up_refer_count+1))
hist(df$pillar_ratio)
hist(df$extension_ratio)
hist(df$generalization_ratio)
hist(df$refer_dist_mean)
hist(df$title_dist_mean)

df_no_outliter = subset(df, citation_count < exp(6)
                          & up_refer_count < exp(5)
                          & pillar_ratio < 0.8
                          & refer_dist_mean < 0.4
                          & title_dist_mean < 0.3
                          & title_dist_mean > 0.05)



model_foundation = feols(scale(pillar_ratio)~
                    + log(up_refer_count + 1)
                    + log(citation_count + 1)
                    + scale(title_dist_mean)
                    + scale(refer_dist_mean)
                    | pub_year
                    , data = df_no_outliter)
summary(model_foundation)



model_extension = feols(scale(extension_ratio)~
                    + log(up_refer_count + 1)
                    + log(citation_count + 1)
                    + scale(title_dist_mean)
                    + scale(refer_dist_mean)
                    | pub_year
                    , data = df_no_outliter)
summary(model_extension)





model_gen = feols(scale(generalization_ratio)~
                    + log(up_refer_count + 1)
                    + log(citation_count + 1)

                    + scale(title_dist_mean)
                    + scale(refer_dist_mean)
                    | pub_year
                    , data = df_no_outliter)
summary(model_gen)



```



### The relationship between F, E, G index and within-paper distance (title and references) (Replicate Table S6)
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(modelsummary)
library(stargazer)
library(fixest)

# for title and reference
# input: get_combine_within_dist.py non-by-domain output (by_domain_type=None,
# the _no_abs full table); columns already match.
df <- fread("../openalex/data/merged_stats/merged_dist_min_y_1951_max_y_2025_p_l_5_r_t_1_c_t_5_no_abs.csv", select = c("pub_year", "citation_count", "up_refer_count", "pillar_ratio", "extension_ratio", "generalization_ratio", "refer_dist_mean", "title_dist_mean", "journal_refer_count", "title_token_count"))

hist(log(df$citation_count+1))
hist(log(df$up_refer_count+1))
hist(df$pillar_ratio)
hist(df$extension_ratio)
hist(df$generalization_ratio)
hist(df$refer_dist_mean)
hist(df$title_dist_mean)
hist(log(df$journal_refer_count+1))
hist(log(df$title_token_count+1))



df_no_outliter = subset(df, citation_count < exp(6)
                          & up_refer_count < exp(5)
                          & pillar_ratio < 0.8
                          & refer_dist_mean < 0.4
                          & title_dist_mean > 0.1
                          & title_dist_mean < 0.35
                          & journal_refer_count < exp(5)
                          & title_token_count > exp(1)
                          & title_token_count < exp(3.5))

t = subset(df, citation_count > 1000& up_refer_count < exp(5)
                          & pillar_ratio < 0.8
                          & refer_dist_mean < 0.4
                          & title_dist_mean > 0.1
                          & title_dist_mean < 0.35
                          & journal_refer_count < exp(5)
                          & title_token_count > exp(1)
                          & title_token_count < exp(3.5))


model_foundation = feols(scale(pillar_ratio)~
                    + log(up_refer_count + 1)
                    # + log(citation_count + 1)
                    + log(journal_refer_count + 1)
                    + log(title_token_count + 1)
                    + scale(title_dist_mean)
                    + scale(refer_dist_mean)
                    | pub_year
                    , data = df_no_outliter)
summary(model_foundation)
summary(df_no_outliter$title_token_count)


model_extension = feols(scale(extension_ratio)~
                    + log(up_refer_count + 1)
                    # + log(citation_count + 1)
                    + log(journal_refer_count + 1)
                    + log(title_token_count + 1)
                    + scale(title_dist_mean)
                    + scale(refer_dist_mean)
                    | pub_year
                    , data = df_no_outliter)
summary(model_extension)





model_gen = feols(scale(generalization_ratio)~
                    + log(up_refer_count + 1)
                    # + log(citation_count + 1)
                    + log(journal_refer_count + 1)
                    + log(title_token_count + 1)

                    + scale(title_dist_mean)

                    + scale(refer_dist_mean)

                    | pub_year
                    , data = df_no_outliter)
summary(model_gen)


summary(scale(df_no_outliter$title_dist_mean))

```
